data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean 2D game FX sprite sheet on a solid #FF00FF background, arranged as exactly 2 rows by 2 columns (four equal frames). Use the provided guide image only as a layout reference for cell placement, spacing, and centering; do not draw any guides, borders, labels, safe-area marks, or grid lines in the final image. Each frame must be centered within its cell, consistent scale across all four frames, and contained within the central 65% of each cell with nothing crossing cell edges.

Theme: moonlit jellyfish ocean special-card trigger effect. It should look like a translucent chrysanthemum halo made of jellyfish-like light rays, elegant and readable at small card size, not an explosion.

Frame 1: tiny moon-white glow with a pale blue aura.
Frame 2: translucent jellyfish-tentacle rays unfolding evenly around the center.
Frame 3: full moon-jelly chrysanthemum halo, pearly white and pale cyan, soft circular rim, delicate droplets.
Frame 4: fading moonlit rays, floating bubbles, faint translucent ring.

Effect only: no playing card, no explosion, no fire, no smoke, no fragments, no tearing, no UI, no text, no icons. HD ocean fantasy card-game effect, soft luminous translucency, delicate specular highlights, subtle depth, clean edges on magenta key background.
